description: This file is a jQuery plugin implementation for the markItUp! Universal MarkUp Engine, providing functions for text editing, markup insertion, and preview rendering within a web application.

methods.name: markItUp
methods.description: Main plugin function to initialize the markup editor with customizable settings and event handling.

methods.name: markItUpRemove
methods.description: Removes the markItUp editor from the selected elements.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Helper function to replace '~/' with the root path in URLs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the editor UI components.

methods.name: dropMenus
methods.description: Recursively builds dropdown menus for toolbar buttons.

methods.name: magicMarkups
methods.description: Processes markup strings with placeholders and prompts.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares actions or strings for insertion, applying markup processing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the markup block to be inserted based on user selection and button configuration.

methods.name: markup
methods.description: Handles the insertion of markup into the textarea based on button clicks.

methods.name: fixOperaBug
methods.description: Workaround for linefeed issues in Opera browser.

methods.name: fixIeBug
methods.description: Workaround for linefeed issues in Internet Explorer.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts the constructed markup into the textarea at the current cursor position.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the cursor or selection range within the textarea.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current selection and cursor position within the textarea.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Opens or toggles the preview window for the markup content.

methods.name: refreshPreview
methods.description: Triggers the rendering of the preview content.

methods.name: renderPreview
methods.description: Loads and displays the preview content, either via AJAX or local template.

methods.name: writeInPreview
methods.description: Writes the generated preview HTML into the preview window.

methods.name: keyPressed
methods.description: Handles key events for shortcuts and special key combinations within the editor.
